component: preset.dropdown: creatable variant versus the search field rule
explanation: Found while building GitManager (not reported by the owner). preset.dropdown says not to use a search field when there are 7 options or fewer, and AP-009 says to put Create inside the dropdown (type a new name, then Create). The creatable variant needs a text field to type the name, so a creatable dropdown with one or two options must either show the search field (breaking the first rule) or lose in-list creation (breaking AP-009). GitManager's profile select has one to three profiles and shows the field, labelled 'Search or create profile' by the reference Dropdown. Two reasonable readings give different results.

classification.rationale: preset.dropdown whenNotToUse (no search field for 7 options or fewer) and the creatable variant with AP-009 conflict for small creatable lists. Two readings give different interfaces. Suggested change: state that a creatable dropdown always shows its text field, or define a Create row that opens an inline name field.
